description: Hand-written questions over the sample corpus in sample_data/. 'expected' marks the single page (PDF) or section (Markdown) that contains the answer; each was checked against the document text by the author. 'keywords' are facts a correct answer should contain. Questions with expected=null are out of scope: a correct system must report insufficient evidence.
